---
name: interview-drill
description: Run an interview drill for HAL/IOCL/UCO Bank or other interview-driven tracks using factual story banks.
agent: hal-prep
---

Use [../../MSTC/HR-QUESTION-BANK.md](../../MSTC/HR-QUESTION-BANK.md), [../../MSTC/BEHAVIORAL-QUESTION-BANK.md](../../MSTC/BEHAVIORAL-QUESTION-BANK.md), [../../MSTC/CAREER-STORY-BANK.md](../../MSTC/CAREER-STORY-BANK.md), and [../../Resume-Berkadia.tex](../../Resume-Berkadia.tex) as source of truth. For HAL/IOCL, adapt to technical + HR blend (HAL 15% interview weightage, IOCL GD/GT + PI).

Run a short mock interview that:

- asks one self-introduction question (40s script, anchored to STMicro + Berkadia + UCO Bank DIT)
- asks 2 HR questions (PSU motivation, why HAL/IOCL, bond awareness)
- asks 2 behavioral questions (STAR, resume-true only)
- asks 1 technical rapid-fire (from the candidate's strongest subject to build momentum)
- scores the answers for clarity, credibility, and specificity
- identifies which story should be strengthened next and what to update in `.brain` if gaps emerge
